title: Independent study pack: quantitative skills and Project 3 HR (weeks 3 and 4)
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y10 lesson 54 (Independent study pack: quantitative skills (percentages, averages, ratios) and Project 3 HR (weeks 3 and 4, pupil PDF))
intro: Work through one section a day. All data is fictional. Show the formula and your working.

questions.q: Sales rose from £48,000 to £54,000. Calculate the percentage change.
A business's costs fell from £20,000 to £17,000. Calculate the percentage change.
Weekly sales of cakes: 120, 135, 110, 150, 135. Find the mean, median and mode.
Why might a manager prefer the median to the mean?
questions.a: It is not distorted by one unusually high or low week.

questions.q: A team has 4 managers and 36 staff. Write the ratio of managers to staff in its simplest form.
20 staff left a firm of 250 last year. Calculate labour turnover.
Two bakers earn £12 an hour for 35 hours a week. Calculate the weekly wage cost.

checklist: Job description: title, duties, hours, pay, place
Advert and where it will be placed, with a reason
Presentation slides ready for the week of 7 June
